title: Tadhla the Falcon
description: Tadhla, Masseira's "Falcon," has been on a mission for a long time and has not returned. Thus Masseira asks you to find his "Falcon"...

mainQuestExcel.title: Tadhla the Falcon
mainQuestExcel.description: Tadhla, Masseira's "Falcon," has been on a mission for a long time and has not returned. Thus Masseira asks you to find his "Falcon"...

dialogs.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, esteemed Master of the Jinni. To what do I owe the pleasure?
Splendid. Another desert-spawn. My master, I— *sigh* Never mind. I trust your judgment.
Could you spare a minute for me? I've been looking forward to seeing you as I've been to seeing the moon and rain.
Don't let us doubt your intent. Just cut to the chase.
Very well, Master of the Jinni, I do have a request...
Haha, nothing serious. It's just my Falcon, Tadhla. I think she's in danger.
*sigh* If it weren't for my weak legs, I wouldn't be troubling you for this...
Correct Paimon if she's wrong. You want us to rescue her before thanking us profusely, paying us a large sum of Mora, and treating us to a big meal for our triumph, right?
Uh... Yes, yes.
Well, if that's the case, we'll do it!
Paimon always gets extra logical when it comes to such situations...
*sigh* Alright, let's do it for Paimon's big meal.
Thank you so much. I'm counting on you.
Let me mark out her last known location.
The person you need to look for, Tadhla, is tall, tanned, with light-colored long hair, and uses a long bow. Yes, this should be enough information about her.
Did you get it all?
Hmm... A tall, tanned girl with light-colored long hair and holds a long bow! Hehe, Paimon has an excellent memory!
May the wind guide you through sandstorms and away from danger.
Thank you. We'll see you soon!
Did you find her?
I see, you still need some time.
Please find her as soon as possible. Time is not on our side.

flow.stepDescription: Go to Tadhla's last known location

dialogs.text: Shh... See? There's someone over there!
Hmm... My master, be those the people whom you mentioned? The "Fooltui"?
It's the "Fatui."
That name makes them sound no wiser.
Shh! Keep it down! If they see us...
Be placid. They hear nothing of my words. Here, bear witness...
Ahoy! You! Corpulent one! Over here! Time to eat!
Hmm? Did you hear anything?
No, why?
Hmm... I thought I heard someone saying time to eat.
Hehe, see?
Paimon didn't know Liloupar has a childlike side! Hehe, it's adorable.
Look! Over there! Is that Tadhla they got locked up?
Hmm... Tall, tanned, light-colored long hair... That should be her.
Well done, little one. The task is upon us, my master.
#Yeah, {NICKNAME}, let's do this!
Um... Are you Tadhla? We are here to get you out!
Yes...? Oh, yes.
You let them go.
They are no longer a threat.
...They will flee and send warning to their comrades. Soon, they will all know that we are here.
The wise are joined of thought. I like this girl.
It doesn't matter. If they come back for us, we'll just kick their butts again! Although... you're injured. Do you need help?
I'm okay. I can still walk and find myself a decent place to die in peace.
Oh, that's a relief, she can still walk and find herself a decent place to— Hey! That's not what Paimon expected to hear!
Just kidding.
Hahaha.
I like this girl's humor... Her vagaries are most amusing.
Thank you. Let's return to the tribe.
Is it difficult to walk?
It is, but I don't need any help.
You don't even need any rest?
Rest? No. I barely know you.
Then, perhaps we should get more acquainted. What say you?
Thank you, but maybe later.
We don't need to kill them.
Ah, here's my little Falcon! Thank you so much!
Sorry, I was ambushed. It was all thanks to them that I can return and see you again.
"Them"? Your "them" is our esteemed Master of the Jinni!
I'm sorry...
Oh come on, it's okay! Tadhla is injured, be nice to her!
You're injured?
I'm sorry.
By what? Animal, or human?
It was the northerners. They ambushed me after realizing they were being followed.
You should've been the ambusher.
Being attacked by the prey. What a shame for a Falcon.
Go rest. I'll tend to your wound later.
Tadhla silently nods and slowly treads away in pain.
Masseira sure is a bit too strict with Tadhla...
Are you two not getting along?
Hmm? No, that would be nonsense. She's my favorite Falcon. I love her, but I don't spoil her. How do you feed a Falcon if the Falcon comes back empty-handed?
Ah, so such is the case... An ugly end awaits this girl.
Please accept this. You have my gratitude, esteemed Master of the Jinni.
Ahem. Aren't you forgetting something? There are still two of us besides your Master of the Jinni.
Hehe, Paimon doubts both of us are qualified to accept the reward...
Ah... Yes, of course. The fact that this floating fairy is technically not a person has eluded me till thus, but perhaps the rest of us people may receive due thanks?
Hey!
Haha, my apologies. Please take this as an extra payment.
Ooh, extra payment!
...Still more paltry than my expectations... But I suppose I will accept this if you should not object, my master.
Very well. If you are available in the future, please come back one more time. I think my Falcon will need your help by then.
Please don't be too harsh to her.
Harsh? No, instead I've been too kind to her. That's why she has become so... sloppy. All I'm doing is educating her. She's an outstanding Falcon. How could I ever hurt her?
So, then, what stands as the most common fate to grace a Falcon...
